init.title: Configure meal planner
init.description: Choose 1 to 6 dishes per day, each with its own servings. Reducing the count keeps existing meals. Optionally sync ingredients and check marks both ways with a writable Home Assistant to-do list. Turning sync off keeps the selected target and existing items. Pair the target list with Apple Reminders in the iPhone Companion app.

error.invalid_meals_per_day: Choose a whole number from 1 to 6.
error.missing_target: Select a target shopping list to enable sync.
error.unsupported_target: Select another to-do list that supports adding, updating and deleting items. The generated Meal Planner list cannot be used as its own target.

user.title: Set up meal planner
user.description: Local recipes, weekly meal planning and a shopping list for your household. The interface is set up automatically. An existing meal planner dashboard is kept. No cloud account required.

abort.already_configured: The meal planner is already configured.
